## Documentation Change Summary

- **Type:** [ ] Fix / Typo  [ ] Improve Existing Guide  [ ] New Guide
- **File(s) modified or added:** `firstissue-doc/...`

### What changed?
<!-- Briefly describe what you updated or added and why it helps contributors. -->

### Checklist
- [ ] Frontmatter (`title`, `description`, `readTime`, `updated`, `difficulty`, `order`) is present and valid
- [ ] Previewed the guide locally with `npm run dev` on `/docs/<section>/<article>`
- [ ] Verified Markdown parsing with `node --test src/utils/__tests__/docMarkdownParser.test.js`
- [ ] Verified no broken links or formatting issues
